description: Connect or replace a billing read key on one product and import coupons, or omit token to import again with the stored key. provider is stripe (rk_), paddle (pdl_* with discount.read), polar (polar_oat_ with discounts:read), lemon-squeezy (API key; store_id when more than one store), dodo-payments (dodo_live_ / dodo_test_), or revenuecat (V2 secret with discounts:read; project_id when more than one project). Does not publish coupons. Optional product_ids limit which billing products apply.

project_id.description: RevenueCat project id when the key can see more than one project.

provider.description: Required when token is set. stripe, paddle, polar, lemon-squeezy, dodo-payments, or revenuecat.

store_id.description: Lemon Squeezy store id when the key can see more than one store.

token.description: Billing read key. Omit to sync with the stored key.

name: connect_coupon_provider
